newsitem.title: USA: Williams, PBS to announce joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Williams, PBS to announce joint venture.

text.p: Williams Cos will announce on Thursday a joint venture with the Public Broadcasting System to deliver business-education services to desktop computers, industry sources said.

Spokesmen for Williams and PBS declined comment, but PBS has scheduled a news conference here this morning with an unidentified U.S. company listed among the Fortune 500 rankings of major American corporations.
Williams is a natural gas pipeline group with a large telecommunications network.

Williams operates an extensive system of fiber optic cables, commonly laid in disused energy pipelines, and will use the cables to deliver a wide array of training and educational programs to businesses.
Industry sources said the services could save employers substantial sums in travel expenses and labor by making training much more accessible at worksites.
Typical offerings might be a review of new U.S. health regulations or a lecture by a leading business thinker.
The joint venture will also exploit the large library of educational programs held by PBS, one industry source said.
Sun Microsystems Inc, whose chief executive Scott McNealy is to appear at the news conference, will supply technology to the enterprise, a source said.
